'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Iran proxy conflict]]
**[[United States|U.S.]] and [[Arab states of the Persian Gulf|Arab]] officials disclose a clandestine [[Israel]]i naval operation against vessels in the [[Persian Gulf]], [[Mediterranean Sea]] and [[Red Sea]] carrying [[Iran]]ian oil and weaponry to [[Syria]] since 2019. At least twelve Iranian vessels have been bombed with [[limpet mine]]s, according to U.S. officials. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/israel-strikes-target-iranian-oil-bound-for-syria-11615492789 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
*[[2021 Myanmar protests]]
**Twelve protesters are killed as security forces open fire on [[2021 Myanmar coup d'état|anti-coup]] protests. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/myanmar-protesters-killed-deadly-violence-1.5946118 (CBC News)]
*Militants raid a school in [[Zamfara State|Zamfara]], killing a student during an attempted mass kidnapping. As the kidnap fails, the attackers fled and started shooting in the streets, killing twelve more people. It is the [[Zamfara kidnapping|second school attack]] in Zamfara in two weeks. [https://allafrica.com/stories/202103110596.html (AllAfrica)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]], [[American Rescue Plan Act of 2021]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] signs the [[United States dollar|$]]1.9 trillion relief package into law. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/03/11/biden-1point9-trillion-covid-relief-package-thursday-afternoon.html (CNBC)]
**[[Economy of Brazil]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***The [[National Congress of Brazil]] approves an $8 billion spending package to help deal with the second wave of the pandemic in [[Brazil|the country]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/152609c9-8162-4bdc-aeef-4c3f8829d66f (''Financial Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Cairo clothing factory fire]]
**At least 20 people are killed and 24 others injured in a fire at a clothing factory in [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/11/egypt-at-least-20-dead-in-cairo-clothing-factory-fire (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Italy]]
*****The [[Italian Medicines Agency]] bans a batch of [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]s as a precautionary measure following the death of three military officers in [[Sicily]] who had been vaccinated. [http://www.ansamed.info/ansamed/en/news/sections/politics/2021/03/11/italy-bans-astrazeneca-batch-amid-reports-of-deaths_f28e671c-4dea-47e7-9ee1-63199f68ce1b.html (Ansamed)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belarus]], [[Lineage B.1.1.7]]
****[[Belarus]] reports its first case of the Lineage B.1.1.7 variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]], which originated in the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-belarus-variant-idUSR4N2L303E (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Norway]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Iceland]]
****The [[Danish Health Authority]] temporarily suspends the use of the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine for two weeks as a "precaution" following reports that some vaccinated people had experienced [[blood clot]]s, causing one person to die after receiving the vaccine. It has not been determined whether there is a link between the vaccine and the clots. [[Norway]] and [[Iceland]] have also suspended their use of the vaccine. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/03/11/denmark-suspends-use-of-astrazeneca-vaccine-over-reports-of-blood-clots.html (CNBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Hungary]] reports a record 8,312 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 489,172. [https://hungarytoday.hu/coronavirus-update-thursday-data-new-infections-record-all-time-high-covid-deaths/ (Hungary Today)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal|Portuguese]] [[Prime Minister of Portugal|Prime Minister]] [[Antonio Costa]] announces that kindergartens, hair salons, bookshops, libraries, pre-schools and primary schools will be allowed to reopen March 15, as a part of the country's gradual easing of its two-month [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]]. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-03-11/portugal-extends-covid-19-emergency-end-of-lockdown-in-sight (U.S. News & World Report)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]]
****[[Victoria, Crown Princess of Sweden]] and [[Prince Daniel, Duke of Västergötland]], test positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.thelocal.se/20210311/swedens-crown-princess-victoria-tests-positive-for-covid-19/ (''The Local Sweden'')]
***The [[European Commission]] grants the approval of single-dose [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|Johnson & Johnson]] vaccine for general use. It comes after the [[European Medicines Agency]] recommends the conditional marketing authorisation for the vaccine. [https://www.brusselstimes.com/news/eu-affairs/159481/johnson-johnson-vaccine-given-eu-authorisation-commission-ursula-von-der-leyen-european-medicines-agency-pfizer-moderna-astrazeneca-single-dose/ (''The Brussels Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia]]
****[[Cambodia]] reports its first death from COVID-19. The patient is a 50-year-old man from [[Phnom Penh]]. [https://www.khmertimeskh.com/50823632/cambodia-announces-first-covid-19-death/ (''Khmer Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] receives a shipment of 150,000 doses of the [[India]]n [[Covaxin]] vaccine. [https://m.timesofindia.com/world/middle-east/iran-says-received-150000-doses-of-indias-covid-jab/amp_articleshow/81449456.cms (''The Times of India'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the State of Palestine]]
****The [[Gaza Strip]] receives 40,000 doses of the [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] vaccine from the [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/H13oSpDX00 (Ynet)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Metropolitan Manila Development Authority]] announces a uniform curfew in [[Metro Manila]] for two weeks beginning on March 15 in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/metro-manila-mayors-impose-curfew-march-15-2021 (Rappler)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****The [[Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency]] extends the use of the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine to people aged 65 and older as overseas trials show its effectiveness. [http://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20210311000126 (''The Korea Herald'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Benin]]
****[[Benin]] receives a shipment of 144,000 doses of the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine from [[India]] through the [[COVAX]] vaccine-sharing initiative. [https://www.ecofinagency.com/public-management/1103-42436-benin-receives-the-first-batch-of-covid-vaccine-under-the-covax-initiative (Ecofin Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Eswatini]]
****[[Eswatini]]  receives a shipment of 20,000 doses of the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine through the COVAX vaccine-sharing initiative. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/health/swaziland-gets-vaccine-doses-braces-for-vaccination/2173131 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Rwanda]]
****[[Rwanda]]n [[President of Rwanda|President]] [[Paul Kagame]] becomes the first [[head of state]] in [[East Africa]] to receive a dose of the COVID-19 vaccine. [https://www.africanews.com/2021/03/11/rwanda-s-kagame-is-first-east-african-leader-to-receive-covid-vaccine/ (Africanews)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Minnesota]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****[[Minnesota]] reports its first case of the 501.V2 variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]], which originated in [[South Africa]]. The patient is a person from the [[Twin Cities]] area who became ill on January 24 and tested positive on January 29. [https://kstp.com/coronavirus/first-case-of-south-african-covid-19-variant-found-in-minnesota-/6039754/ (KSTP-TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington (state)]], [[Lineage P.1]]
****[[Washington (state)]] reports its first case of the Lineage P.1 variant of SARS-CoV-2, which originated in [[Brazil]]. The patient is a person from the [[King County, Washington|King County]]. [https://apnews.com/article/public-health-health-virology-washington-coronavirus-pandemic-df69ce8eb077f83f1f39f7c65cc987b8 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Dakota]], [[Lineage B.1.1.7]]
****[[South Dakota]] reports its first case of the Lineage B.1.1.7 variant of SARS-CoV-2, which originated in the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://rapidcityjournal.com/news/local/state-and-regional/uk-variant-of-covid-19-confirmed-in-south-dakota/article_4e4cb76a-b13b-5db3-a112-0ada83f08236.html (''Rapid City Journal'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**Catalan politician [[Meritxell Serret]] surrenders to the [[Supreme Court of Spain|Supreme Court]] after three years in self-imposed exile in [[Belgium]] following the declaration of independence in 2017 and her imputation of a crime of disobedience. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/catalan-separatist-returns-from-belgium-to-face-spanish-law/2021/03/11/a2c386f4-8281-11eb-be22-32d331d87530_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Andrew Cuomo sexual harassment allegations]], [[New York COVID-19 nursing home scandal]]
**The [[New York State Assembly]]'s judiciary committee is authorized to initiate an impeachment investigation into sexual misconduct allegations against Governor [[Andrew Cuomo]]. Earlier that day, more than 50 state lawmakers had called for Cuomo's resignation in the wake of the allegations and his handling of deaths at nursing homes due to COVID-19. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/03/11/politics/andrew-cuomo-new-york-democrats-call-for-resignation/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Constitution of Kyrgyzstan]]
**The [[Kyrgyzstan]] [[Supreme Council (Kyrgyzstan)|Parliament]] approves a new referendum on a draft constitution that would expand the powers of [[President of Kyrgyzstan|President]] [[Sadyr Japarov]] and allow him to run for office again after his term ends. The referendum will be held on April 11. [https://www.brecorder.com/news/40072567 (''Business Recorder'')]
*[[China]]'s [[National People's Congress]] passes the "[[2021 Hong Kong electoral reform|decision on improving the electoral system of Hong Kong]]", which will rewrite the [[Elections in Hong Kong|election rules]] in [[Hong Kong]] to ensure a system of "patriots governing Hong Kong". This is seen by many Western countries as further eroding the freedoms of the Hong Kong people. [https://www.npr.org/2021/03/05/973921684/beijing-prepares-hong-kong-election-laws-further-erasing-freedoms (NPR)]
*[[Pope Francis]] appoints Archbishop [[Leo Boccardi]], until now [[apostolic nuncio]] in [[Iran]], as apostolic nuncio in [[Japan]]. [https://press.vatican.va/content/salastampa/en/bollettino/pubblico/2021/03/11/210311b.html (Holy See Press Office)]
